hero.title: Empowering Healthcare with Digital Prescriptions
hero.description: Presciya is the premium, ultra-fast Digital Prescription platform crafted for clinics, hospitals, and personal doctors in Bangladesh. Streamline workflows, search local medicines instantly, and focus on patient care.

features.title: Prescription Engine
features.description: Write prescriptions in less than 60 seconds with auto-complete, saved templates, and built-in local medicine databases.

features.title: Local Medicine Database
features.description: Comprehensive, up-to-date database of generic and brand-name medications approved by DGDA Bangladesh.

features.title: Multi-Chamber Management
features.description: Switch between multiple chambers seamlessly. Keep patients, histories, and analytics organized per practice location.

features.title: Enterprise Grade Roles
features.description: Role-based access control (RBAC) designed for Personal Doctors, Assistants, Clinics, and Medical Institutions.

pricing.title: Simple, Transparent Pricing
pricing.description: Choose the perfect plan for your practice size. Start writing prescriptions today.

tiers.name: Personal Lite
tiers.description: Perfect for independent practitioners starting out.

tiers.name: Personal Pro
tiers.description: Ideal for established doctors with active practices.

tiers.name: Clinic / Institution
tiers.description: Designed for multi-doctor facilities and small clinics.
